properties.dataset: LIDAR Composite First Return Digital Surface Model (FZ_DSM) - 1m

field_evidence.dataset_identity: Official Environment Agency First Return DSM 1m metadata record and identifier.
field_evidence.surface_model: Official metadata states first-return DSM includes heights of surface objects such as buildings and vegetation plus terrain where first/only return was ground.
field_evidence.coverage: Official metadata states approximately 99% England coverage.
field_evidence.resolution: Official metadata states 1 m spatial resolution.
field_evidence.date: Official metadata exposes creation 2023-02-08, revision 2023-12-15 and period 2016-11-11 through 2022-05-05.
field_evidence.license: Official metadata states Open Government Licence and no public access constraints.
field_evidence.accuracy: Official lineage states vertical accuracy +/-15 cm RMSE.
field_evidence.service_access: Official record exposes download, WMS, WFS metadata catalogue, WCS, WMTS and OGC API links.
